title: 고기 포장 라벨 읽기: 어느 부위, 어디 고기예요?
objective: By the end, you can read a Korean meat package label and find the cut (부위), the origin (원산지), what the meat is for, and how much you pay.
summary: Learners read Korean supermarket meat labels to find the cut, the country of origin, the use, the weight, and the price.
note: The store name, prices, and dates on these labels are examples only.

task.title: Read meat labels
task.line: Read each label or situation, then choose, fill in, or answer with the words from this worksheet.

sections.heading: Read the label
paragraphs: [라벨 1] 두루마트 / 품명: 돼지고기 목살(구이용) / 원산지: 국내산 / 중량: 600g / 100g당 가격: 2,500원 / 판매가격: 15,000원 / 포장일: 2026.10.10
[라벨 2] 두루마트 / 품명: 소고기 양지(국거리용) / 원산지: 호주산 / 중량: 400g / 100g당 가격: 4,000원 / 판매가격: 16,000원 / 포장일: 2026.10.10

items.text: It tells you where the meat comes from.
Country name + 산 means the meat comes from that country.
It tells you which part of the animal the meat is.
A fatty pork cut, often grilled.
A pork cut with less fat than pork belly.
The meat is cut for grilling or pan-frying.
The meat is cut small for soup.
It shows how heavy the meat is, in grams.
It shows the price of 100 grams, so you can compare packs.

sections.heading: Reading tips
paragraphs: 품명 usually reads like this: animal + cut + (use). For example, 돼지고기 목살(구이용) means pork collar for grilling.
판매가격 is the price you pay. To check it, use this rule: 100g당 가격 × (중량 ÷ 100). For example, 2,500원 × 6 = 15,000원.

exercises: Read the label and answer: [소고기 등심(구이용) / 원산지: 미국산 / 중량: 300g] ① 어느 나라 고기예요? ② 몇 그램이에요?
Choose 구이용 or 국거리용: ① 주말에 캠핑장에서 고기를 구울 거예요. ② 내일 아침에 소고기뭇국을 끓일 거예요.
You want domestic meat only. Can you buy it? Write Yes or No: ① 원산지: 캐나다산 ② 원산지: 국내산
Find the price you pay: 돼지고기 삼겹살 / 중량: 400g / 100g당 가격: 3,000원 → 판매가격: ____원
Fill in the blank with 부위 or 원산지: ① 삼겹살, 목살, 양지는 고기의 ____예요. ② 국내산, 호주산, 미국산은 고기의 ____예요.
